entries.statement: {parentCount dimension : ℕ} → (Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) → Fin dimension → TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairBitType → Finset (TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairLayer parentCount 1)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes
entries.statement: {parentCount dimension : ℕ} → (Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) → (TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairLayer parentCount 1 → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) → Fin dimension → TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairBitType → Finset (TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairLayer parentCount 1)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes_card_le
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (children : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairLayer parentCount 1 → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension) (bitType : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairBitType), (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes parents children coordinate bitType).card ≤ (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate bitType).card

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupHomogeneousEquiv
entries.statement: {parentCount dimension : ℕ} → (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) → (coordinate : Fin dimension) → (outcome : Bool) → ↥(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate (if outcome = true then 1 else 0)) ≃ ↥(Finset.powersetCard 2 (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairParentCoordinateSupport parents coordinate outcome))

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup_card_le
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension) (bitType : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairBitType), (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate bitType).card ≤ parentCount.choose 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup_false_card
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension), (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate 0).card = (parentCount - TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairParentCoordinateOneCount parents coordinate).choose 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup_homogeneous_card
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension) (outcome : Bool), (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate (if outcome = true then 1 else 0)).card = (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairParentCoordinateSupport parents coordinate outcome).card.choose 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup_mixed_card
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension), (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate 2).card = (parentCount - TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairParentCoordinateOneCount parents coordinate) * TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairParentCoordinateOneCount parents coordinate

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup_probability_mul_childComplement
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ}, 2 ≤ parentCount → ∀ (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (children : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairLayer parentCount 1 → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension) (bitType : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairBitType), ↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate bitType).card / ↑(parentCount.choose 2) * (1 - ↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes parents children coordinate bitType).card / ↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate bitType).card) = (↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate bitType).card - ↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes parents children coordinate bitType).card) / ↑(parentCount.choose 2)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup_probability_mul_childRatio
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ}, 2 ≤ parentCount → ∀ (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (children : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairLayer parentCount 1 → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension) (bitType : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairBitType), ↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate bitType).card / ↑(parentCount.choose 2) * (↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes parents children coordinate bitType).card / ↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate bitType).card) = ↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes parents children coordinate bitType).card / ↑(parentCount.choose 2)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup_true_card
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension), (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate 1).card = (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairParentCoordinateOneCount parents coordinate).choose 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.retainedHammingHost
entries.statement: (dimension : ℕ) → ℕ → (retained : Set (Bool × TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension)) → SimpleGraph ↑retained

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.retainedHammingHost_edgeFinset_card
entries.statement: ∀ (dimension radius : ℕ) (retained : Set (Bool × TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension)), (TwoDegenerateGraphs.retainedHammingHost dimension radius retained).edgeFinset.card = (TwoDegenerateGraphs.retainedHammingWordEdges dimension radius retained).card

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.retainedHammingWordEdges
entries.statement: (dimension : ℕ) → ℕ → Set (Bool × TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) → Finset (TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension × TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.retainedVertex_card_le_manuscriptVertexCount
entries.statement: ∀ (dimension : ℕ) (retained : Set (Bool × TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension)), TwoDegenerateGraphs.hammingRetainedVertexCount dimension retained < 3 * TwoDegenerateGraphs.hammingRetentionProbability dimension * ↑(2 ^ dimension) → Fintype.card ↑retained ≤ TwoDegenerateGraphs.manuscriptVertexCount dimension

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.sampledHammingEdgeEntropyRate
entries.statement: ℝ

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.sampledHammingEdgeEntropyRate_eq_manuscriptExtremalPower
entries.statement: TwoDegenerateGraphs.sampledHammingEdgeEntropyRate = (1 - TwoDegenerateGraphs.midpointBeta) * TwoDegenerateGraphs.manuscriptExtremalPower * Real.log 2 + 2 * TwoDegenerateGraphs.manuscriptEntropyGap

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.sampledHammingEdgeEntropyRate_pos
entries.statement: 0 < TwoDegenerateGraphs.sampledHammingEdgeEntropyRate

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.sqrt_three_mul_entropyTangentRho
entries.statement: √3 * TwoDegenerateGraphs.entropyTangentRho = √2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.sum_pairCoordinatePairMismatchCount
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (children : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairLayer parentCount 1 → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension), ∑ pair, TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairCoordinatePairMismatchCount parents children coordinate pair = 2 * (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes parents children coordinate 0).card + (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate 2).card + 2 * ((TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate 1).card - (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes parents children coordinate 1).card)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.sum_pairCoordinatePairMismatchCount_eq_hammingDist
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (children : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairLayer parentCount 1 → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension), ∑ coordinate, ∑ pair, TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairCoordinatePairMismatchCount parents children coordinate pair = ∑ pair, ∑ parent ∈ ↑pair, hammingDist (parents parent) (children pair)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.sum_pairTypeGroupChildOnes_card
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (children : TwoDegenerateGraphs.PairLayer parentCount 1 → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension), ∑ bitType, (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroupChildOnes parents children coordinate bitType).card = TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairChildCoordinateOneCount children coordinate

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.sum_pairTypeGroup_card
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ} (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension), ∑ bitType, (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate bitType).card = parentCount.choose 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau
entries.statement: ℝ

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau_complement
entries.statement: 1 - TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau = √3 * TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau_lt_one_half
entries.statement: TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau < 1 / 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau_pos
entries.statement: 0 < TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau_reciprocal_identity
entries.statement: 1 + 1 / √3 = (1 - TwoDegenerateGraphs.tau)⁻¹

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.twoDegenerateExtremalCounterexample
entries.statement: ∃ q H, H.Connected ∧ H.IsBipartite ∧ TwoDegenerateGraphs.IsTwoDegenerate H ∧ (∀ (coloring : H.Coloring (Fin 2)) (side : Fin 2), 2 < {vertex | coloring vertex = side}.sup fun vertex => H.degree vertex) ∧ ∃ c ε, 0 < c ∧ 0 < ε ∧ ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, c * ↑n ^ (3 / 2 + ε) ≤ ↑(SimpleGraph.extremalNumber n H)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairExpectation
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → (Bool → Bool → ℝ) → ℝ

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairExpectation_error
entries.statement: ∀ (parentCount oneCount : ℕ), 2 ≤ parentCount → oneCount ≤ parentCount → ∀ (f : Bool → Bool → ℝ), (∀ (left right : Bool), 0 ≤ f left right ∧ f left right ≤ 1) → |TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairExpectation parentCount oneCount f - ∑ left, ∑ right, TwoDegenerateGraphs.independentBinaryPairMass (↑oneCount / ↑parentCount) left right * f left right| ≤ 1 / ↑parentCount

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairExpectation_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ (parentCount oneCount : ℕ), 2 ≤ parentCount → oneCount ≤ parentCount → ∀ (f : Bool → Bool → ℝ), (∀ (left right : Bool), f left right ≤ 1) → TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairExpectation parentCount oneCount f ≤ 1

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairExpectation_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ (parentCount oneCount : ℕ), 2 ≤ parentCount → oneCount ≤ parentCount → ∀ (f : Bool → Bool → ℝ), (∀ (left right : Bool), 0 ≤ f left right) → 0 ≤ TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairExpectation parentCount oneCount f

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairExpectation_sub
entries.statement: ∀ (parentCount oneCount : ℕ), 2 ≤ parentCount → ∀ (f : Bool → Bool → ℝ), TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairExpectation parentCount oneCount f - ∑ left, ∑ right, TwoDegenerateGraphs.independentBinaryPairMass (↑oneCount / ↑parentCount) left right * f left right = ↑oneCount / ↑parentCount * (1 - ↑oneCount / ↑parentCount) / (↑parentCount - 1) * (f false true + f true false - f false false - f true true)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairMass
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → Bool → Bool → ℝ

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairMass_eq_pairTypeGroup
entries.statement: ∀ {parentCount dimension : ℕ}, 2 ≤ parentCount → ∀ (parents : Fin parentCount → TwoDegenerateGraphs.HammingWord dimension) (coordinate : Fin dimension) (left right : Bool), TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairMass parentCount (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairParentCoordinateOneCount parents coordinate) left right = ↑(TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairTypeGroup parents coordinate (TwoDegenerateGraphs.pairBitTypeOfOutcomes left right)).card / ↑(parentCount.choose 2) * if left = right then 1 else 1 / 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairMass_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ (parentCount oneCount : ℕ), 2 ≤ parentCount → oneCount ≤ parentCount → ∀ (left right : Bool), 0 ≤ TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairMass parentCount oneCount left right

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairMass_sum
entries.statement: ∀ (parentCount oneCount : ℕ), 2 ≤ parentCount → ∑ left, ∑ right, TwoDegenerateGraphs.withoutReplacementBinaryPairMass parentCount oneCount left right = 1

entries.name: CompactnessConjecture.FamilyFree.member
entries.statement: ∀ {family : Finset CompactnessConjecture.FiniteGraph} {forbidden : CompactnessConjecture.FiniteGraph}, forbidden ∈ family → ∀ {n : ℕ} {host : SimpleGraph (Fin n)}, CompactnessConjecture.FamilyFree family host → forbidden.graph.Free host

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.averageDisagreement
entries.statement: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel → ℝ

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.averageDisagreement_eq_four_outcomes
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel), kernel.averageDisagreement = (1 - kernel.parentProbability) ^ 2 * kernel.childProbability false false + kernel.parentProbability * (1 - kernel.parentProbability) + kernel.parentProbability ^ 2 * (1 - kernel.childProbability true true)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.bitDisagreementProbability
entries.statement: Bool → ℝ → ℝ

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.bitDisagreementProbability_mem_Icc
entries.statement: ∀ (parent : Bool) (childProbability : ℝ), 0 ≤ childProbability → childProbability ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.bitDisagreementProbability parent childProbability ∧ TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.bitDisagreementProbability parent childProbability ≤ 1

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.childMarginal
entries.statement: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel → ℝ

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.childMarginal_eq_four_outcomes
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel), kernel.childMarginal = (1 - kernel.parentProbability) ^ 2 * kernel.childProbability false false + (1 - kernel.parentProbability) * kernel.parentProbability * kernel.childProbability false true + kernel.parentProbability * (1 - kernel.parentProbability) * kernel.childProbability true false + kernel.parentProbability ^ 2 * kernel.childProbability true true

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.childMarginal_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel), kernel.childMarginal ≤ 1

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.childMarginal_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel), 0 ≤ kernel.childMarginal

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.conditionalEntropy
entries.statement: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel → ℝ

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.conditionalEntropy_bound
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel), kernel.conditionalEntropy ≤ TwoDegenerateGraphs.kappa + TwoDegenerateGraphs.logTwo 3 * kernel.averageDisagreement + (TwoDegenerateGraphs.binaryEntropy kernel.childMarginal - TwoDegenerateGraphs.binaryEntropy kernel.parentProbability) / 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.conditionalEntropy_bound_of_marginal_interior
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel), 0 < kernel.childMarginal → kernel.childMarginal < 1 → kernel.conditionalEntropy ≤ TwoDegenerateGraphs.kappa + TwoDegenerateGraphs.logTwo 3 * kernel.averageDisagreement + (TwoDegenerateGraphs.binaryEntropy kernel.childMarginal - TwoDegenerateGraphs.binaryEntropy kernel.parentProbability) / 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.conditionalEntropy_logsum_reduction
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel), 0 < kernel.childMarginal → kernel.childMarginal < 1 → kernel.conditionalEntropy * Real.log 2 - Real.binEntropy kernel.childMarginal / 2 - Real.log 3 * kernel.averageDisagreement ≤ TwoDegenerateGraphs.binaryConditionalLogPotential kernel.parentProbability √(1 - kernel.childMarginal) √kernel.childMarginal - Real.binEntropy kernel.parentProbability / 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.conditionalEntropy_mul_log_two
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel), kernel.conditionalEntropy * Real.log 2 = (1 - kernel.parentProbability) ^ 2 * Real.binEntropy (kernel.childProbability false false) + (1 - kernel.parentProbability) * kernel.parentProbability * Real.binEntropy (kernel.childProbability false true) + kernel.parentProbability * (1 - kernel.parentProbability) * Real.binEntropy (kernel.childProbability true false) + kernel.parentProbability ^ 2 * Real.binEntropy (kernel.childProbability true true)

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.smoothed
entries.statement: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel → (mixing : ℝ) → 0 ≤ mixing → mixing ≤ 1 → TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.smoothedConditionalEntropy
entries.statement: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel → ℝ → ℝ

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.smoothedConditionalEntropy_continuous
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel), Continuous kernel.smoothedConditionalEntropy

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.smoothed_averageDisagreement
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel) (mixing : ℝ) (hmixing_zero : 0 ≤ mixing) (hmixing_one : mixing ≤ 1), (kernel.smoothed mixing hmixing_zero hmixing_one).averageDisagreement = (1 - mixing) * kernel.averageDisagreement + mixing / 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.smoothed_childMarginal
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel) (mixing : ℝ) (hmixing_zero : 0 ≤ mixing) (hmixing_one : mixing ≤ 1), (kernel.smoothed mixing hmixing_zero hmixing_one).childMarginal = (1 - mixing) * kernel.childMarginal + mixing / 2

entries.name: TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel.smoothed_conditionalEntropy
entries.statement: ∀ (kernel : TwoDegenerateGraphs.BinaryPairKernel) (mixing : ℝ) (hmixing_zero : 0 ≤ mixing) (hmixing_one : mixing ≤ 1), (kernel.smoothed mixing hmixing_zero hmixing_one).conditionalEntropy = kernel.smoothedConditionalEntropy mixing

entries.statement: ∀ {V : Type u_1} (P : TwoDegenerateGraphs.ParentSystem V) (v u : V), P.graph.Adj v u ↔ v ≠ u ∧ (u ∈ P.parents v ∨ v ∈ P.parents u)
